name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.307.0 — Gate scope and slow tier: the grounding contract gains the optional slowTestCommand key and a Test tiers section (the fast testCommand tier versus a once-per-legs-iteration blocking slow leg); init profiles runner path-acceptance and boot/build/service tests, asks where the slow tier lives and writes {testDirs} into gateCommand; doctor check 25 reports an unscoped gate and a missing slow tier. 7.306.0 — Thirteen gate scripts drop their private stdout writer for lib/sync-write.js, so a reader that closes early (| head) no longer turns their verdict into an EPIPE stack trace; a standing sweep test fails the moment a new writeSync copy appears under spec/scripts/. 7.305.0 — port-check, spec-number-check, workspace-scan, design-contract-check and catalog-inventory now write stdout through the shared lib/sync-write.js: EAGAIN retries and a closed reader (EPIPE) no longer crash them.
